notes.title: Devlog: An assortment of improvements
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Just a quick update on what's happening with the game:


 There's now a full controller support!
 Reworked the upgrade trees systems. Everything is much more balanced and the choice between upgrades should be more interesting
 Improved sounds and music
 Refactored all the menus to be more intuitive
 Fixed a lot of smaller bugs and issues


ALSO: the demo will be available during the June Steam Next Fest (or potentially even a bit earlier…), wishlist the game if you want to be notified when that happens!

Thanks for reading!


— Michał

notes.title: Devlog: Added a shotgun!
notes.content:
… and a blunderbuss! There are also new biomes in the game, with tricky gravity wells and powerful sandstorms!

New guns for you to experience

Joining the standard pistol, you will be able to unlock two new guns: a shotgun and a blunderbuss.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45495348/5e8a94c7c619d52bac71c6a61a91789684969681.png

The shotgun fires multiple bullets per shot, but these are weaker and they have a shorter range. The blunderbuss has a long reload time, but fires only one massive bullet (in the picture I also have an upgrade that makes the bullets _even_ bigger and sometimes shoots two more, so that's why there are three of them!).

Biomes

On your way down, you will now encounter different biomes that will change how you and your bullets fly through the air. Moss will slow you and bullets down, sandstorms will blow you randomly left and right, and gravity anomalies will make your bullets take unexpected trajectories.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45495348/e861415561c29da1200d982940151157981efb8d.png

If this looks fun, wishlist Gun in a Well, to be able to experience it when the games comes out!
